text:
Nina: Opened PR to adjust Cascade-7B and Polaris-13B model cards: clarify deployment limits, add benchmark entries for small-batch vs large-batch, and fix SDK v3 snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/820. Need bench/SDK reviews.

Olaf: Noted a swap: the "peak_tokens/s" and "median_tokens/s" columns look reversed in the CSV table. Also Polaris embed dims listed as 1536 but model uses 1024.

Pat: Bench run I did on p4d (seq=4096, batch=2) for Cascade-7B: median=980 tokens/s, 95p=760. I uploaded CSV: https://internal-storage/redwood/bench/cascade7b/2026-03-22.csv

docsbot: PR #820 created by nina  docs-lint: passed; bench-ci: queued.

Maya: SDK snippet: I'll update Python + TS to use the new `max_output_tokens` field and add a streaming example that gracefully falls back to a smaller model if latency policy hits. Will push shortly.

Olaf: For deployment limits, recommend adding a short table: Hosted (g5.x): seq<=2048, Dedicated (p4d): seq<=8192, Private: depends on infra. Small note on quant profiles: Cascade-7B int8 requires runtime >=2.4.2 or use variant `cascade7b-no-quant`.

Nina: Made the table and corrected the embed dim. PTAL. If bench numbers are final I'll update the median/95p and merge.

Pat: CSV uploaded and bench-ci passed. Numbers updated.

Maya: Pushed SDK snippets and added a migration note for users moving from SDKv2 naming.

Olaf: LGTM, left one nit about wording in the compatibility sentence.

Nina: Fixed wording and merging now. Will post to #release-war-room and ping infra for runtime rule updates.

Pat: Thanks team!
